title: Eclipse & Veil Apothecary
description: A silhouetted figure in a hat and coat sits at a desk in a mystical apothecary, gazing toward a large arched window displaying a vibrant red and black solar eclipse over a starry cityscape. The room is filled with glowing potion bottles, magical herbs, an ornate mirror reflecting the eclipse, an open spellbook with red symbols, and a glowing lantern.
prompt: A lone silhouetted alchemist in a wide-brimmed hat sits at a wooden desk inside a Victorian apothecary at night. Through a grand arched window behind him, a striking red solar eclipse glows above a starry city skyline. The room is filled with shelves of glowing potion jars, magical plants, an ornate mirror reflecting the eclipse, an open book of red sigils, and a glowing blue lantern. Mystical, detailed, rich colors, dark fantasy atmosphere.
